title: Open Recent shows a render of a file when hovered
body: File > Open Recent in acre-gui lists paths only. Hovering an entry should show a small render of that drawing beside the menu: built on a background thread with its fonts and data files read relative to it, a spinner until it is ready, cached by path and modification time, and the error line instead of a picture for a missing or broken file.
close_reason: Landed in 104eac2. `Previews` in `crates/acre-gui/src/preview.rs` renders each hovered Open Recent entry on a background thread and caches it by path and modification time. The free function `build` in `app.rs` reads a drawing's fonts and data files for both the viewer and the preview.
